linhas.en: "That could be interpreted as a compliment."

linhas.en: Clothes for slender people wouldn't look good at all on Ryudou, also his skin isn't pretty, [cacheimage storage=凛巫女服01i(中)][wvl][chgfg time=300 storage=凛巫女服01i(中)]all soft and smooth without a single blemish, grrr!"
